7.t: Working with data: a health survey
q: How many students sleep under 6 hours?
What percentage sleep the recommended 8 hours or more?
Describe the link between sleep and mood.
Mood rises with sleep up to about 8 to 9 hours, then levels off.
Can we conclude that more sleep causes better mood? Explain.
Not certain: it is a correlation. Other factors (stress, screen time, health) could affect both. An experiment changing sleep would be needed.
